scenarios.name: cast-a-spell-earthbends-one
scenarios.why: Any spell you cast matches Toph's SpellCast trigger, so earthbend 1 targets a land you control and puts one +1/+1 counter on it. Lightning Bolt is not a Lesson, so the chained rider (ConditionDefined$ TriggeredCardLKICopy | ConditionPresent$ Lesson) does not add an extra counter.

scenarios.name: casting-a-lesson-adds-an-extra-counter
scenarios.why: The Art of Tea is an Instant Lesson, so the Lesson rider's condition is met: after earthbend 1 puts the first counter, the chained PutCounter sub adds one additional +1/+1 counter to the same land.
